```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(janitor)
library(knitr)
library(scales)
library(forcats)
```

# Data

```{r include=FALSE}
file <- "Data/SBJ-SIAP-WebinarParticpants-2026-10-21.xlsx"

df <- read_excel(file) %>%
  clean_names()

names(df)
```

```{r}
# Names
participants <- df %>%
  select(
    country = country_or_area,
    first_name,
    family_name,
    organization,
    sex,
    email = e_mail
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    country = str_trim(country),
    country = str_to_title(country),
    sex = str_to_title(sex),
    organization = str_squish(organization), 
    sex = ifelse(sex =="Male", "Men", "Women")
  )
```

##  Total Number of Participants

```{r}
n_participants <- nrow(participants)
n_japan <- nrow(subset( participants, participants$country == "Japan"))


kable(
  data.frame(
    Indicator = "Total Participants",
    Value = n_participants
  )
)
```

##  Number of Countries Represented

```{r}
country_summary <- participants %>%
  mutate(country_std = case_when(
    str_detect(country, "Japan|日本") ~ "Japan",
    str_detect(country, "Kyrgyz") ~ "Kyrgyzstan",
    str_detect(country, "Armenia") ~ "Armenia",
    str_detect(country, "Iran") ~ "Iran",
    str_detect(country, "Viet") ~ "Viet Nam",
    str_detect(country, "Hong Kong") ~ "Hong Kong, China",
    str_detect(country, "Brunei") ~ "Brunei Darussalam",
    str_detect(country, "Thailand|Bankok") ~ "Thailand",
    str_detect(country, "Fiji") ~ "Fiji",
    str_detect(country, "Georgia") ~ "Georgia",
    TRUE ~ country
  ))

n_countries <- n_distinct(country_summary$country_std)

kable(
  data.frame(
    Indicator = "Countries Represented",
    Value = n_countries
  )
)
```

# Details on Participants 

```{r}
country_table <- country_summary %>%
  count(country_std, sort = TRUE)

# kable(country_table)
```

```{r fig.height=6}
ggplot(country_table,
       aes(x = reorder(country_std, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2C7FB8") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Participants by Country",
    x = "",
    y = "Number of Participants"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
country_table <- country_summary %>%
  count(country_std, sort = TRUE)

kable(country_table)
```


##  Gender Disaggregation

```{r}
gender_table <- participants %>%
  count(sex) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = percent(n / sum(n))
  )

kable(gender_table)
```

```{r}
ggplot(gender_table,
       aes(x = sex, y = percent, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Gender Distribution",
    x = "",
    y = "Participants"
  ) +
   scale_fill_manual(values = c( "Men"  = "darkgreen", 
                                 "Women" = "purple"))+
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# Institutional Classification

The organization field is classified into:

1. National Statistical Office (NSO)
2. Ministry / Government Agency
3. Other Institution


```{r}

participants_classified <- participants %>%
  mutate(
    org_lower = str_to_lower(organization),
    org_type = case_when(
      str_detect(
        org_lower,
        paste0(
          "statistic|census and statistics|agency on statistics|",
          "\\b(geostat|armstat|turkstat|rosstat|capmas|dosm|nso|bps)\\b"
        )
      ) ~ "National Statistical Office",

      str_detect(
        org_lower,
        "ministry|cabinet office|government|office of the prime minister|\\b(mospi|miti)\\b"
      ) ~ "Ministry/Government",

      TRUE ~ "Other Institution"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-org_lower)
```


```{r}
org_table <- participants_classified %>%
  count(org_type) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)
  )

kable(org_table)
```

```{r}
# Institutions plot

ggplot(org_table,
       aes(x = fct_reorder(org_type, n, .desc = FALSE), y = n, fill = org_type)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Participants by Institution Type",
    x = "",
    y = "Participants"
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_flip()+
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```


### Organizations Classified as "Ministries" (check)

```{r}
participants_classified %>%
  filter(org_type == "Ministry/Government") %>%
  count(organization, sort = TRUE) %>%
  kable()
```



### Organizations Classified as "Other Institutions" (check)

```{r}
participants_classified %>%
  filter(org_type == "Other Institution") %>%
  count(organization, sort = TRUE) %>%
  kable()

n_NSO <-  org_table %>% 
   filter(org_type == "National Statistical Office") %>% 
   pull(n)

n_Min <- org_table <-  org_table %>% 
   filter(org_type == "Ministry/Government") %>% 
   pull(n)
```


This webinar gathered **`r n_participants`** participants over the last two days, from Japan of course (**`r n_japan`** participants) , but also from  **`r n_countries`** different countries.

Participants were from both government/statistical offices ( **`r n_NSO`** participants ) and other ministries ( **`r n_Min`** , *estimated*).
